comment: Real, unmodified open-source apps from F-Droid's official repository (https://f-droid.org/repo), pinned by version and SHA-256, for tests/e2e/run-e2e.ps1 (docs/e2e.md). APKs are downloaded in CI only. knownFailure: why the app does not pass yet (docs/e2e.md); its FAIL line does not fail the job. display: WxH, the app runs on a device of its own with that display (GESHER_DISPLAY). waitLog: a regex the app's log must show after the actions (waited for up to 120 s).

apps.label: RPN calculator
apps.why: A calculator: one Activity of plain framework widgets (Buttons in a layout), pure Java, no AndroidX; asks for the vibrator.

apps.label: Editor
apps.why: A text editor: a full-window EditText, menus, SharedPreferences, files; pure Java, no AndroidX.

apps.label: Currency
apps.why: A converter: ListView with an adapter, SharedPreferences, an EditText, a network fetch of rates that must fail gracefully; pure Java.

apps.label: NoNonsense Notes
apps.why: Notes and to-do lists: SQLite through its own ContentProvider (SQLiteOpenHelper, Cursors), AndroidX AppCompat and Material, preferences.

apps.label: Unit Converter Ultimate
apps.why: A unit converter: AndroidX AppCompat, Material components (navigation drawer, toolbar), RecyclerView, fragments, Java and Kotlin.

apps.label: Signal Generator
apps.why: Audio (docs/media.md): a tone generator that plays through AudioTrack (Builder defaults: the output's rate, the minimum buffer) from onResume on; custom views (scale, knob, display), pure Java, no AndroidX. Its activity asks for landscape (userLandscape) and its views size themselves only when their parent is wider than tall: on the default 400x800 display its task turns (windows3 track, docs/windows3.md), its window is 800x400.

apps.label: Notes
apps.why: A notes app that shows its note as Markdown in a WebView (loadDataWithBaseURL with the note's file:/// folder, assets' styles, JavaScript, a WebViewClient) under a floating edit button; pure Java, no AndroidX (docs/webview.md). A fresh install has no note: the edit button, a word, the accept button render it.

apps.label: Simon Tatham's Puzzles
apps.why: NDK: the puzzles are C code (lib/x86_64/libpuzzles.so) driven over JNI, drawing on a Canvas through Java callbacks; new games come from lib/x86_64/libpuzzlesgen.so, an ELF executable run with ProcessBuilder (docs/exec.md); AndroidX AppCompat.
apps.waitLog: gesher: exec pid [0-9]+ exited with status 0

apps.label: TIC-80
apps.why: Ships native code only for arm64-v8a (Phase 7, docs/arm64.md): the TIC-80 fantasy console and SDL2 in C (lib/arm64-v8a), run by the arm64 translator; SDLActivity's JNI both ways, native threads, EGL/GLES 2 on the Activity's window.
apps.knownFailure: its arm64-v8a libraries load and run translated (SDL's JNI_OnLoad and three nativeSetupJNI calls into ART) and its window opens, but SDL draws into an SDLSurface (a SurfaceView), which Gesher's graphics stack does not give a Surface yet (docs/media.md, docs/devices.md), so SDL's main thread never starts and the window stays black (ci 40237320424)
